events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired COCO MADEMOISELLE fragrance experience centered on the new CRUSH ABSOLU scent, with personalized fragrance discovery and access to the broader COCO MADEMOISELLE beauty lineup.
events.what_is_free: Entry and the fragrance experience are free. Walk-ins are encouraged; appointments are limited but recommended for easier access.
events.caveats: CHANEL states that appointments are limited and walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. Walk-in access can still depend on real-time capacity.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13 and September 19–20 run 10 AM–7 PM; September 18 runs noon–7 PM. Use CHANEL's official event page for current appointment availability, but an appointment is not required for walk-in access.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A NYFW nail activation at Rockefeller Center celebrating Sally Hansen's Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection with nail touch-ups, photo moments and product play.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the activation, including nail-focused experiences and photo moments. Specific giveaway inventory is not promised by the official host page.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center lists the activation as part of its free, public NYFW programming. Individual beauty services can still be capacity-limited on site.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink.

events.what_it_is: A brownstone-inspired NYFW recharge pop-up with hair and skincare touch-ups, a photo booth, complimentary coffee, branded stickers and Calzedonia legwear shopping.
events.what_is_free: Walk-in access, complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, photobooth access and advertised skincare sampling. Embroidery is free with purchase of the qualifying 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Current sources agree the pop-up is open to the public. Some elements are while supplies last, and embroidery requires purchase of the qualifying knee highs.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13, 12–5 PM daily at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is stated in the current sources.
